summary: Implemented the Admin notifications inbox and audit-log list/detail surfaces for ADM-65 and ADM-66 using the implemented API contracts. The UI provides localized Admin Desktop navigation, loading, empty, error, retry, forbidden, not-found, success, unread/read, pagination, audit filters, safe detail projections, and role-aware mutation behavior without exposing internal data. A narrow accessibility-test repair replaced incidental label/call-shape coupling with semantic assertions for the current runtime.

The accessibility assertions use semantic current behavior rather than incidental label counts; no runtime request was added to satisfy a test.
Admin Dashboard is Desktop-only under the approved scope. Test fixtures are test-only and no Production mock or credential was used.
DESIGN-EXCEPTION-ADM-54 remains an active project-level owner waiver for ADM-54 only; it is not used as design evidence for ADM-65 or ADM-66.
